question: One morning, Chitrashi and Aryan sit facing each other. If the shadow of Aryan falls to the left of Chitrashi, then in which direction is Aryan facing?
solution:
One morning, Chitrashi and Aryan sit facing each other. 

 
• If the shadow of Aryan falls to the left of Chitrashi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b78a1831c3fefce572cbef9cf51aa8a71495a3338fd435ff01095d07b432a01.png] 

 
• Aryan is facing the South direction.

Hence, **‘South​’ **is the correct answer.
